uncoveredRules.name: Single Shipment Weight Limit
uncoveredRules.description: A single shipment cannot exceed 1000 kg gross weight. This limit exists due to carrier insurance maximums and warehouse loading dock constraints.

uncoveredRules.name: Carrier Must Be Active
uncoveredRules.description: A carrier must have active=true to be assigned to new shipments. Inactive carriers may have lapsed insurance or suspended operations.

uncoveredRules.name: Address Must Be Validated Before Dispatch
uncoveredRules.description: The destination shipping address must be validated (geocoded and confirmed deliverable) before a shipment can be dispatched. This reduces failed delivery attempts.

uncoveredRules.name: 30-Day Return Window
uncoveredRules.description: Returns can only be initiated within 30 days of the delivery date. After this window, returns must be approved through a manual exception process.
testScenarios: POST /returns within 30 days of delivery succeeds

uncoveredRules.name: Warehouse Cannot Exceed Capacity
uncoveredRules.description: Inventory additions to a warehouse are rejected if they would cause the currentOccupancy to exceed the warehouse's declared capacity.
testScenarios: POST /warehouses/:id/inventory that would exceed capacity returns 409

uncoveredRules.name: Unique Tracking Events
uncoveredRules.description: A tracking event is considered a duplicate if a record with the same trackingNumber, status, and timestamp already exists. Prevents double-posting from carrier webhook integrations.
testScenarios: POST /tracking/events with same payload twice returns 409 on second call

uncoveredRules.name: Hazardous Materials Require Certified Carrier
uncoveredRules.description: Shipments containing hazardous materials (isHazmat=true) can only be assigned to carriers with hazmatCertified=true. This is a DOT compliance requirement.
testScenarios: POST /shipments with isHazmat=true and non-certified carrier returns 409
POST /shipments with isHazmat=true and certified carrier succeeds

uncoveredRules.name: High-Value Shipments Require Insurance
uncoveredRules.description: Shipments with declaredValueUsd > 5000 must have insured=true before they can be dispatched. This protects against loss claims.
